description: Figure 4 illustrates the relationship between the number of tokens used during training and the resulting Macro-F1 scores for two methods: MATTER and a method without material knowledge. The x-axis is labeled “Number of Tokens” and has a linear scale ranging from 0.6 to 1.4, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The y-axis is labeled “Macro-F1 Score” and has a linear scale ranging from 48 to 58, with tick labels at intervals of 2. A blue solid line represents MATTER (ours), starting at approximately 51.2 when the number of tokens is 0.6 and increasing to approximately 57.8 when the number of tokens is 1.4. A red dashed line represents the method without material knowledge, beginning at approximately 49.2 when the number of tokens is 0.6 and rising to approximately 54.2 when the number of tokens is 1.4.
